title: Cashback Missed Opportunity by Merchant
dataSources: Micro-spend transactions (`microspend:txn`), cashback events (`cashback:event`), price tracker alerts (`pricetrack:alert`), and tip logs (`tiplog:shift`).
app: Micro-finance telemetry for latte-factor spending, cashback apps, price tracking, and tip logging sent to Splunk HEC via finance exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cashback:event
| search missed_amount>0
| stats sum(missed_amount) as missed_amount count as misses by merchant_name
| sort 0 - missed_amount
description: Ranks merchantss by missed cashback opportunities.
value: A merchant leaderboard for missed value shows where one reminder or browser tool would pay for itself.
implementation: Send missed cashback opportunities events to `index=personal` and keep `merchant_name` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of missed cashback opportunities by merchants.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which merchantss stand out most for missed cashback opportunities.
